paraphrase: Steiner names Osiris in his sequence of ways the Christ Being was known in mystery traditions.
interpretation_qualification: This is his esoteric reading of those traditions.

title: VI. The Present and Future of Cosmic Evolution — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner presents the exalted Sun Being as the archetype of love, whose seed is placed in human nature.
interpretation_qualification: Earth adds love to the wisdom inherited from earlier evolution.

title: Michael's Mission in the World Age of Human Freedom — GA 26. Anthroposophical Guiding Principles
paraphrase: Steiner connects Christ’s spiritual warmth with activity that makes freedom possible and assigns the originating free deed to the I.
interpretation_qualification: He distinguishes GA 4’s philosophical route from the spiritual experience described here.

title: Michael's Mission in the World Age of Human Freedom — GA 26. Anthroposophical Guiding Principles
paraphrase: Michael’s work is brought into harmony with the Mystery of Golgotha in the world age of human freedom.
interpretation_qualification: Michael is named as an Archangel. The Christ relation is stated at another theological level.

title: IX. The Idea of Freedom — GA 4. The Philosophy of Spiritual Activity (1963) | Michael's Mission in the World Age of Human Freedom — GA 26. Anthroposophical Guiding Principles
paraphrase: GA 4 treats moral intuition and love of the deed as sources of free action. GA 26 attributes the free to the human I.
interpretation_qualification: GA 26 explicitly distinguishes the basis of GA 4 from spiritual experience of Michael.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner places the Luciferic intervention in human astral development and connects it with independence and vulnerability to error.
interpretation_qualification: The account gives the intervention mixed consequences.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner connects Ahrimanic influence with an increasingly misleading grasp of sensory existence and with consequences beyond death.
interpretation_qualification: The Luciferic and Ahrimanic accounts overlap in their effects but are differentiated.

title: Seventh Lecture — GA 113. The East in the Light of the West
paraphrase: Steiner treats the historical descent of Christ as a prerequisite for the later possibility of an inward mystical Christ experience.
interpretation_qualification: This is the lecture’s specific account of why modes of revelation change.
